text:
sam.r: Heads-up: inbound claim timeouts spiking again during enrichment tail. Proposal: add a short grace+jitter before RR fallback so owners get a tiny extra window.
violet.k: Agree. Would prefer campaign opt-in and jitter capped to 40% of timeout.
lee.p: For HubSpot we can publish `routing_timeout` and `routing_jitter` properties and have workflow respect them. Also set `fastlane_label=true` when fallback happens.
sdr-ops: SDR note: if a lead gets fastlane=true please add a HS task template 'Quick qualify - fastlane' so we don't waste time.
hubspot-bot: Created sandbox properties `routing_timeout` and `routing_jitter`.
routing-bot: Suggested config: timeout=18s, jitter=6s, fallback_queue=sdr-overflow-quick. Will run sim in CI.
sam.r: Rollout plan: sandbox test -> read-only publish -> single-campaign canary (ebook-gated) -> monitor fastlane_rate and claim_success -> iterate.
violet.k: Add alert: page marketing-oncall if fastlane_rate > 1.5% on revenue campaigns.
lee.p: Also set SF flag `DoNotMerge=true` while enrichment pending to avoid dupes. salesforce-sync-bot: Rule queued.
sam.r: I'll open RFC with sim logs and GH ticket. Can we start canary next Wednesday?
sdr-ops: We'll prep the HS task template and a short Slack playbook for SDRs. :thumbsup:
